text:
sam: starting eu-west change-window deploy for search-service v3.7.0. plan: 10% -> 35% -> 100% over 25m. watch p95, 429s, connection_pool_usage. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: [deploy] search-service v3.7.0 -> canary 10% (eu-west). id=deploy-1809991234. preflight ok.

monitor-bot: SLO snapshot: p95 baseline 120ms -> current 128ms (+6.6%), 429 rate 0.0%, conn_pool_util 48%.

tara: loading dash now. will spin up a synthetic load at canary qps to match prod mix.

sam: if 429 > 0.3% or conn_pool_util > 70% we pause and consider pin to v3.6.8. pin command: `deploy-bot pin-version search-service v3.6.8 --scope eu-west --reason "connpool pressure"`

monitor-bot: alert: short spike in 429s to 0.6% (1m aggregate) during warm ramp. conn_pool_util jumped to 82% on canary pods.

tara: seeing connection pool exhaustion on the new client implementation in v3.7.0 (changed default max_conns from 200 -> 100). traces show increased queuing at outbound HTTP client.

sam: oof. expected client to use keepalives; looks like dialing overhead. can we hotpatch runtime config to increase max_conns to 250 for canary?

infra-bot: runtime-override applied to canary: `search.client.max_conns=250`. change id=cfg-1809991234.

monitor-bot: after override: conn_pool_util down to 58%, 429s back to 0.05%, p95 to +3%.

tara: recommend hold at 10% for two windows (10m) to ensure stability under sustained burst.

pm-lee: flagging PM/CS — holding rollout for EU while we validate. I'll update release notes with the runtime tweak as a known-good mitigation.

sam: agreed. if conn_pool_util returns >75% or 429s >0.5% we will pause and pin EU to v3.6.8. Otherwise proceed to 35% at t+10m.

deploy-bot: hold engaged. autoscaler note: scaled canary pool x1 during early spike. keep an eye on small-n noise.

monitor-bot: FYI: small-n variance observed after pod restart; using 5m smoothing for decisioning.

sam: thanks all. tara, please post a short trace sample on next update. planning to run the pin command manually only if stabilization fails. :thumbsup:
